quiz.0.question: Which sustainable farming practice has the clearest legal framework and the EU-unified 'Euro Leaf' certification?
quiz.0.explanation: Certified Organic farming is regulated by EU law (EC No 834/2007 and successor regulations) and identified by the green Euro Leaf logo — the clearest, most legally defined sustainability standard.
quiz.1.question: In addition to organic farming, what core philosophy does biodynamic farming emphasise?
quiz.1.options.1: The farm as a self-sustaining ecosystem, guided by cosmic and lunar cycles
quiz.1.options.3: No sulphur additions at any stage
quiz.1.explanation: Biodynamics (based on Rudolf Steiner's lectures) goes beyond organic — treating the farm as a closed, self-sustaining organism, using homeopathic preparations and working according to a lunar calendar.
quiz.2.question: Friuli pioneers such as Josko Gravner became world-famous for reviving which ancient winemaking technique?
quiz.2.options.1: Amphorae/Qvevri fermentation and extended skin contact (orange wine)
quiz.2.explanation: Josko Gravner of Collio travelled to Georgia in the 1990s and returned inspired to ferment white wines in clay amphorae (Qvevri) with months of skin contact — sparking the global orange wine revolution.
quiz.3.question: Which statement about natural wine is most accurate?
quiz.3.options.0: Natural wine has a universally agreed legal definition
quiz.3.options.1: Natural wine has no universally agreed legal definition — it is a concept based on minimal intervention, but standards vary widely between producers
quiz.3.options.2: Natural wine is the same as organic wine
quiz.3.explanation: Unlike organic or biodynamic, 'natural wine' has no binding legal definition or official certification body. It is a philosophy — broadly meaning minimal vineyard and cellar intervention — but its boundaries are interpreted very differently by different producers.
